summary: Backend-only testing of raised K_FACTOR=24 and team_size scaling in compute_player_deltas. Created /app/backend/tests/test_mmr_scaling.py with 8 focused tests covering: 1v1/2v2/3v3 equal-MMR 5-3 per-player |delta| in [15,25], zero-sum invariant (<0.01), 1v1 5-0 blowout upper bound, imbalanced 2v2 underdog-gains-more, leaderboard mmr smoke, admin recompute-all, and player stats peak_mmr_all_time. All 8 new tests PASS; existing test_elo_and_peak.py (5 tests) still PASS = 13/13 (100%). Observed per-player delta ~16.80 for 5-3 equal MMR in 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 — confirming team_size scaling. Blowout 5-0 produces ~24.00 (at ceiling, acceptable). Zero-sum holds across all formats.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_player_deltas correctly scales team_delta_a by team_size so per-player deltas stay K-sized across 1v1/2v2/3v3 while preserving zero-sum (team B gets -team_delta_a distributed equally among team_size players).

K_FACTOR=24 with the current round-diff multiplier (1 + round_diff/max_rounds) produces 16.8 at 5-3 and 24.0 at 5-0 for equal MMR — all within the targeted 15-25 window (5-0 is at the ceiling but acceptable per spec).
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own isolated TEST_ prefixed season/players/matches and clean up on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_mmr_scaling.py and test_elo_and_peak.py both green against K_FACTOR=24. If K is tuned again, update expected per-player delta constants (~16.8 at 5-3 equal MMR, ~24.0 at 5-0) in test_mmr_scaling.py.
